reviews.text:
Great service and stands behind his work.  I had some pretty bad leaks in a couple places on my roof.  The first company I reached out to was Villas and Edgar came out immediately that same day to take a look at the problem.  He took his time crawling thru attics and walked the entire roof with me to clearly diagnose the issues and identify all of the potential problems.  I came away from that first meeting feeling very good about everything we discussed and the solutions that were recommend.  As promised, I had a quote in my email inbox within 24 hours.  The proposal was very detailed including photos of the trouble spots and clearly noting what work would be done to each of those spots.  For the next couple days I had meetings with a few other companies just to get some additional opinions and quotes.  I called all the others the same day I called Villas.  None of the others came out as quickly and none were as thorough as Edgar in trying to identify the issues.

When it came time to start the work, they showed up on time and complete the work in two days exactly as promised.  After they finished my wife had noticed something that looked slightly off about the repair (just a small aesthetic thing), which I brought to Edgar's attention and he came out immediately to fix it to make sure we were 100% satisfied with his work (which we are).  His communication from first meeting thru completion of work was fantastic.  Easy to reach, responsive, professional, and stand behind their quality work.  I highly recommend Villas for any roofing needs.  Thanks again, Edgar!!
